carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowing below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots visible within the silhouette of the dorsal fin in the upper-left field of view.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, dark-toned visual features indicative of remoras are visible trailing the pectoral fin and ventral region.
